about: Shared FrameUp audio library, used by Video Ads (video-ads.html) and, later, Reels Studio. EMPTY ON PURPOSE until the owner adds licensed tracks. To add a track: (1) put the file in assets/audio/ named after its id, e.g. assets/audio/fourth-quarter-drive.mp3 (mp3, m4a or wav; same origin, so the browser can mix it into the export); (2) add an entry to "tracks" below with the fields listed in "fields"; (3) set licence.paid to true ONLY if the licence covers paid ads on every platform (Meta, TikTok, YouTube), and licence.organic to true if it covers organic posts; (4) commit both files. Never add trending commercial songs. Entries with a bad id, path or licence are skipped and the rest still load.

fields.id: lowercase slug, unique, same as the file name (a-z, 0-9, -)
fields.title: track title shown in the picker
fields.licence: { "organic": true|false, "paid": true|false, "note": "licence name and number, e.g. Epidemic Sound Enterprise #1234" }
